claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by setting control-plane architecture across routing, GraphRAG grounding, runtime gates, and human override paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to usage-based forecasting and reusable commercialization patterns.
Strengthened production trust with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, combining evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls for runtime governance.
Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates from intake through monitoring, using managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data paths, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
